headline: Casa 18 allocates $39 million for five real estate projects in Lima
summary: Peruvian real estate developer Casa 18 announced $39 million in capital for five new projects launching in early 2027, including its first office tower.
why: Casa 18 is a boutique commercial and residential property developer operating in Lima, Peru.

impacts.name: Peru
impacts.why: Private real estate investment expands urban office and commercial housing supply.
